metadata.title: फ़रवरी और मार्च से ये आदिवासी औरतें क्यों डरती हैं | Why February bring Fear to indigenous women
metadata.description: In the hilly state of Tripura, February and March bring fear to tribal women as these months mark the dry season with no rain. In numerous tribal villages across Dhalai and Khowai districts, water scarcity is a pressing issue, with streams and ponds running dry. Access to adequate water supply remains a distant dream for many indigenous communities.
